    Instagram @yinmeiquan ↗ Event Information Hub ↗

    DJ at THE PIT & PENDULUM

    6 open slots

    We hire live DJs — mixing recorded tracks live on the decks, not playlists and not live singing. We want specialists: a DJ who owns one genre beats a DJ who claims them all.

    90%

    Your tip jar is yours

    Tip jars pay the DJ 90%. The venue's 10% goes toward the private full-size region both clubs stand on.

    L$250/hr

    Guaranteed on top

    DJ Satanica personally tips L$250 per hour to every DJ at every performance, at both clubs — on top of your jar.

    6

    Slots open now

    2 Rock & Metal · 1 Industrial/Goth · 3 LiveMix Techno & EDM. Proficient live-mix DJs are placed at THE PIT first; PENDULUM by fit.

    Live

    Real rooms, real support

    All-PBR builds, automated stream switching and tip-jar logins, Syntiya promoting every set, and an owner who attends every performance.

    Before You Apply

    1. Your own stream is required. THE PIT & PENDULUM do not provide streams — you must have or rent your own, and have it working before any trial set or performance.
    2. Live-mix, in your genre. Tell us the one or two genres you truly own. Rock & metal, industrial/goth, and LiveMix techno & EDM are what we're hiring for.
    3. Hosts are your call. You may bring your own host; tip-sharing with them is your arrangement, not the venue's.
    4. Apply on the form. Nineteen questions, three sections. If you fit, you'll hear back about a trial set.
    Applications Open

    Ready to play for the family?
